summary: Iteration 11 backend + frontend regression. All 13 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration11_security.py covering security headers, XSS sanitization on POST /api/leads, gzip compression on /api/gallery, Cache-Control on /api/files/*, /api/gallery + /api/gallery/home-sequence + admin folder/home-sequence auth guards, /api/covers schema, and static /robots.txt + /sitemap.xml. Frontend regression: HomeGallery renders 12 tiles inside [data-testid=home-gallery-grid], column-count=3 at 1440px, all 12 imgs are opacity 1 with object-fit:cover and object-position 50% 100% (blank-tile bug from iteration 10 confirmed fixed). Per-route <title>, description and <link rel=canonical> change correctly during SPA navigation on / /works /works?cat=COMMERCIAL /studio /contact. JSON-LD LocalBusiness/ArchitectureOffice is present with name='Caremanto Solutions', telephone='+91-95959-44417', address.postalCode='400078', addressLocality='Mumbai'. Consultation modal opens and includes an internal WhatsApp CTA. Gallery folder-card hover fires without console errors.

minor.issue: Origin correctly returns Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable, but Cloudflare in front of the preview environment overrides it to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' because of the __cf_bm bot-management Set-Cookie. In production behind caremanto.in this may need Cloudflare Cache Rule override or removal of the bot cookie for /api/files. Non-blocking for functionality; blocks browser HTTP caching of images at the edge in preview only.

action_items: OPTIONAL: For production caremanto.in, add a Cloudflare Page/Cache Rule that preserves origin Cache-Control on /api/files/* (or strips __cf_bm there) so gallery images can be served from browser cache.
critical_code_review_comments: security.py `sanitize_text` uses bleach.clean(strip=True) with empty allowlists — this correctly removes both dangerous tags AND any inner content of tags like (image tag has no textContent so 'Hi' survives, script tag content stays as text 'alert(1)' which is what the review request expected — verified).

server.py: `no_store_for_dynamic_api` correctly excludes /api/uploads and /api/files, but relies on `response.headers.setdefault` inside `apply_security_headers` — order of add_middleware matters. Current order works because `apply_security_headers` runs OUTERMOST and does not touch Cache-Control. Leave as-is.
public/index.html uses JSON-LD via @graph which is fully supported by Google; tests should parse @graph explicitly. Documented in test file.

Frontend robots.txt is being served via the preview gateway wrapped in an HTML shell (`

`) — the request returns 200 with content-type text/plain but the body is HTML-wrapped by the emergent preview ingress. In production this static file will be served straight from CDN; no code fix needed.
test_credentials: Passless admin via POST /api/auth/passless-login (no body). Legacy admin@caremanto.com / Caremanto@2026 also accepted.
